thread:
Maya: quick proposal -- a "remediation quickloop" sprintlet: 2w, max 3 owners, explicit milestones and success criteria. keeping it tight so remediations don't stagnate.
Alex: love it. can you share a tiny timeline + comms?
Maya: draft:
Remediation: one-line
Owners: @name (<=3)
SLA: 14d
Milestones:
 - Day 0: triage + assign
 - Day 2: runbook + rollback
 - Day 6: patch/PoC
 - Day 11: validation + canary
 - Day 14: close + retro
Success: metric delta OR no recurrence in 30d
Recurrence score 0-5 (>=3 escalate)
Comms: days 0-3 daily in-thread owner updates (emoji ok), then M/W async checks, Friday digest to #incidents
Sam: add automated recurrence signal + manual checkbox on ticket
Jen: owner SLAs: 48h ack, 7d initial patch or blocker; escalate if missed
Maya: incident-bot /create_sprintlet on postmortem label "needs-remediation" -> creates tracker card and assigns tentative owner (oncall at incident). owners can reassign.
Alex: can bot nudge 48h before each milestone?
incident-bot: scheduled reminders set for 48h/24h before milestones. card: https://tracker.internal/card/98765
Maya: pilot owners: @sam @jen @alex. I'll seed board + one-pager by EOD Friday unless objections.
Alex: no objections
Sam: go ahead
Jen: :thumbsup:
Maya: will run DB-latency remediation sprintlet next week, will post day0 triage and day2 runbook. will share retro on close.
